title: The Sick Calf
offer: The calf of our cow does not drink. Tova says she needs chamomile and a warm stone in her bed. The chamomile is with Tova, the stones are hot in Dagny's kiln on Bergö.

steps.load_say: Chamomile calms her tummy. Give it with warm water.
Hot from the kiln, wrapped in wool. It stays warm all night.

steps.say: She drinks! She drinks! Look at her little tail wag. Supper is on the house tonight.

fact: People put hot stones in their beds to keep warm on cold nights.
